japanese-kana.swsh: もっている　きのみを　たべて ぼうぎょを　ぐーんと　あげる。

korean.swsh: 지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹고 방어를 크게 올린다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 吃掉攜帶的樹果， 大幅提高自己的防禦。

french.swsh: Le lanceur mange la Baie qu’il tient, ce qui augmente beaucoup sa Défense.

italian.swsh: Se chi la usa ha con sé una bacca, la mangia e la sua Difesa aumenta di molto.

english.swsh: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.
english.la: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.
english.sv: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

japanese.swsh: 持っている　きのみを　食べて 防御を　ぐーんと　あげる。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 吃掉携带的树果， 大幅提高防御。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: El usuario ingiere la baya que lleva equipada para aumentar mucho su Defensa.

effect.full: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.
effect.shortEffect: User consumes berry and raises its defense by 2 stages.
